sparkCluster.help: Where a Spark script runs and is validated when its source names no cluster of its own. A source's own cluster is always used when it has one.
sparkCluster.addressHelp: The cluster's Spark Connect address, for example sc://spark.example.com:15002. Leave the token out of it: keep the token as a secret and name it below.
sparkCluster.credentialHelp: A secret reference to the token the cluster is called with, for example ${secret:spark_token}. Leave empty for a cluster that takes no token.
sparkCluster.inUseOrg: Sources that name no cluster use this default ({{target}}).
sparkCluster.inUseLocal: Sources that name no cluster use the local test cluster ({{target}}). Set a default to use your own cluster.
sparkCluster.inUseNone: No Spark cluster is configured: a source that names none cannot run until a default is set.
